editorial: You are dropped headfirst into a claustrophobic nightmare where political ambition collides with raw, primal desperation. Rather than playing a standard kidnapping trope, you watch a calculated dissection of the facade of power as a mayoral candidate is stripped bare in real-time. Ben Affleck’s direction is ruthless, utilizing a ticking-clock structure that makes the city of Los Angeles feel like a tightening noose. It is a visceral exercise in tension that forces you to question exactly how far you would sink to protect your own. If you crave high-stakes psychological warfare over mindless action, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of tight, character-driven suspense and political noir.
